# couchbase-capella_app_service_audit_log_streaming (Resource)

Manages audit log streaming for an App Service.
Destroying this resource disables audit log streaming and removes the collector configuration, including credentials.
Note: The API does not return credentials. After an import, credentials are null in the state, so the next apply sends the configured credentials again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "couchbase-capella_app_service_audit_log_streaming" "new_app_service_audit_log_streaming" {
  organization_id = "<organization_id>"
  project_id      = "<project_id>"
  cluster_id      = "<cluster_id>"
  app_service_id  = "<app_service_id>"

  streaming_enabled      = true
  output_type            = "datadog"
  disabled_app_endpoints = ["<app_endpoint_name>"]

  credentials = {
    datadog = {
      url     = "<datadog_url>"
      api_key = "<datadog_api_key>"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_service_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the appService.
- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `credentials` (Attributes, Sensitive) - Secrets for audit log streaming configuration. Required when starting, resuming or pausing log streaming. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `output_type` (String) - The type of output for the audit log streaming. Required when starting, resuming or pausing log streaming.
 - **Valid Values**: `datadog`, `generic_http`, `sumologic`, `loki`, `elastic`, `splunk`, `dynatrace`
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.
- `streaming_enabled` (Boolean) - Determines whether audit log streaming is enabled or not. To start or resume streaming, set this to true. To disable or pause log streaming, set this to false.

### Optional

- `disabled_app_endpoints` (Set of String) - List of App Endpoints to be excluded from audit log streaming.

### Read-Only

- `log_streaming_state` (String) - The current status of audit log streaming

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import couchbase-capella_app_service_audit_log_streaming.new_app_service_audit_log_streaming app_service_id=<app_service_id>,cluster_id=<cluster_id>,project_id=<project_id>,organization_id=<organization_id>
```
